remarks: Beautifully kept and updated Antique Colonial with the Charm of Yesteryear-adapted to today's lifestyle. Fenced in back yard with additional party deck, sited in the heart of Westport. Convenient to town, schools, shopping, restaurants and train. Hardwood Floors, arched doorways, lovely living room with fireplace, formal dining room, Study/Office and library. Newer, updated white kitchen with marble countertops,soft close drawers, eat in kitchen area, Wolf range, Miele Dishwasher and Subzero Fridge/freezer. Ensuite Primary bedroom with walk in closet, plus two additional bedrooms. Full bath and laundry on second floor. Zoned A/C. City water, city sewer, natural gas. Meandering brook does not affect house in periods of heavy rain. Hardwood Floors, arched doorways, lovely living room with fireplace, formal dining room, Study/Office and library. Newer, updated white kitchen with marble countertops, eat in kitchen, ensuite Primary bedroom, plus two additional bedrooms. Full bath and laundry on second floor.   Vanities in bathrooms to be replaced before new tenant takes possession. Available for lease starting August 19, 2025
